ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous white region (approx. 70% of lobe area) with irregular black pixel streaks originating from the trailing edge. Right lobe is primarily black with high-contrast white mottling and fragmented spots concentrated toward the distal tip and superior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible superior boundary (trailing edge) displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; distinct jagged peaks at pixel coordinates corresponding to the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex sweep transitioning to acute, slightly recurved tips at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel aggregates (barnacle scarring) located on the far lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical linear streaks cutting through the white pigmentation of the left lobe; localized white linear scratches visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized encrustation and associated scarring on distal tips; irregular notch-like absences along the trailing edge margin.
